content: Switch translation layer to user's direct Gemini API key (gemini-2.5-flash) and run full warm-up for BG/RO/EN
Auth backend: users/sessions/credentials collections, argon2 password hashing (min 8), httpOnly session cookie, /api/auth/* routes
Passkeys: discoverable (one-tap, no email) registration + authentication ceremonies with RP ID derived from origin
Login/Register page UI with password + passkey, and auth context in frontend
Gate admin settings page behind login; sync favourites to the account
Mobile header: hamburger to the right; drawer slides down from top; login/register or email+logout at bottom
Send enquiry (Прати запитване) on car detail page with guest + logged-in options
Track my vehicle (Maersk container tracking + MarineTraffic vessel) - needs API credentials from user
